project_name: Goorin B2B Staff Portal — Revenue Ops Dashboard Redesign
archetype: Architectural Craft & High-Density B2B Performance (Goorin Bros Heritage Wholesale)
context: Internal B2B Staff Dashboard (Desktop-First, Light App Shell)

rules.H1_Hero_Figure: font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 3.5rem (56px); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1;
rules.H2_Section: font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem (20px); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: var(--color-slate-900);
rules.H3_Subhead: font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem (17px); font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-slate-800);
rules.KPI_Value: font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 2rem (32px); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
rules.Table_Numeric: font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem (14px); font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
rules.Overline_Labels: font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 0.725rem (11.5px); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase;
rules.Forbidden_Fonts: FORBIDDEN: Space Grotesk (dashboard rule) and Inter for headings.

colors.palette_name: Heritage Emerald, Warm Sand & Deep Obsidian
colors.forbidden_colors_check: VERIFIED ABSENT: No Teal Green/Teal Blue (#1B93A4) used. No purple gradients.

spacing_and_layout.page_container: max-width: 1440px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 12px 16px 48px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px;
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid_mid: display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.8fr 1fr; gap: 24px; align-items: stretch;

hero_section.description: Premium dark obsidian card with heritage green/gold ambient lighting, tactical live dot indicator, Barlow Condensed YTD invoiced figure, sparkline, segmented control, KPI 3-column bento, and goal progress pace bar.

styles.segment_control: sliding white indicator on dark translucent background (calc((100% - 8px) / 3))

elements: Invoiced YTD hero text + delta badge + 9-month sparkline
3 KPI Tiles: Open orders, Total, Forecast with micro vertical spark bars
Annual Goal Progress Bar with pace marker (#d97706 line) and % indicator

chart_card.description: Light & airy Revenue by Month ComposedChart card with range switcher pills (YTD, 12M, Quarter), CSV export button, crisp custom legend, reference line for current month, and cursor-line APCA compliant tooltip.
elements: Header Right: Color legend + Export CSV button
Chart area: Height 380px, responsive, stacked bars for Invoiced/Open, Total blue line, Forecast amber dashed line, reference line on current month

segments_and_top_accounts_card.description: Right side bento column split into top Segments (US Wholesale & Distributors with progress bars & % of goal pills) and Ranked Top 1-5 Accounts list with rank badge, account name, formatted amount, and triangle delta indicators.

account_detail_table.description: Comprehensive B2B account table with live search input, count badge, avatar initials with color seeds, STRATEGIC tags, invoiced horizontal mini-bar, vs Goal pill, YoY delta, and keyboard-accessible accordion expansion showing 5 key metrics and 'Open account' navigation CTA.

motion_and_interactions.card_hover_lift: transform: translateY(-2px); transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Google Fonts link for Barlow Condensed, Outfit, DM Sans, and JetBrains Mono is present in public/index.html or imported in index.css.
Verify all data-testid attributes listed in data_testid_inventory match exactly in DashboardPage.tsx.
Do NOT use Space Grotesk or Inter for headings.
Do NOT use teal green/blue (#1B93A4) anywhere in palette.
Maintain APCA contrast: high contrast dark theme for Hero section, crisp light theme for Chart & Detail sections.
Keep interactive element states (hover, focus-visible) clear with 2px outline offsets.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) on tooltips and floating navs.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). This breaks transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Keep left-aligned natural hierarchy.
Always use modern button styles with clear hover/active micro-interactions.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖, 🧠, 💭, 💡, 🔮, 🎯) for UI icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8, p-12) to avoid cramped layouts.
